lines.text: The woman's beloved knocks at night, asking her to open, and puts his hand to the latch.
She opens the door with her hands dripping with myrrh, but he has turned and gone.
The watchmen beat her and take her sandals, and she asks the daughters of Jerusalem to tell him she is sick with love.
She describes her beloved as outstanding among ten thousand, with a head of purest gold and hair black as a raven.
She says her beloved has gone down to his vineyard to pasture his flock and gather lilies.
